words.gloss: within the boundary of proper conduct

literal: Those who stood within the boundary of propriety will not abandon, even in times of ruin, the friendship of those who stood in long-standing affection.
translation: Those who stand firm within the bounds of propriety will not abandon their relationship with long-standing friends, even in times of ruin.
modern: நட்பின் எல்லையைக் கடக்காமல் வாழ்பவர்கள், தமக்கு அழிவு வந்த காலத்திலும், பழமையான நட்பில் நிலைத்து நின்றவர்களுடைய உறவைக் கைவிட மாட்டார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the enduring nature of true friendship. The phrase 'எல்லைக்கண் நின்றார்' refers to principled individuals who never cross the boundaries of loyalty and proper conduct. 'தொல்லைக்கண் நின்றார்' refers to old, long-standing friends who have maintained their affection over a long period. The poet explains that even when facing complete ruin or adversity ('தொலைவிடத்தும்'), those of noble character will never abandon their ancient bonds, showing that historical loyalty is far more valuable than temporary material circumstances.
